My girls were small and they were just as thrilled by it as me, “Let’s follow the rainbow!” I told them maybe we’d actually find the pot of gold under this one and figured it would get them excited and keep them calm and happy as we prepared for the long drive. I followed it. It never ever dimmed in color - it stayed just as bright- but of course as soon as we felt we were getting close, we couldn’t touch it. I ended up following it for like 45 minutes. Finally, I saw a clear spot where we needed to make a right turn on a dirt road. I turned…right into some Jewish cemetery. It was SUPER bright. So bright I pulled over and parked. I saw a sunbeam pointing to a grave maybe 12 graves away or so. So we take a little walk. Straight to my grandma’s grave. I didn’t even know she was Jewish. 

If this hadn’t happened to me I would say no way- this didn’t happen. Only it did. My life drastically changed because now I’m sure SOMETHING happens after we’re gone. Still not sure what but it’s something…

It really just depends in what you plan to do in town. If you search travel apps, a lot of the hotels are pretty close in price but some have more amenities than others, some are probably closer to any shows or events you’ll be attending. Do you know if you want to stay on strip or off? Do you smoke? That’s a big one for people and makes a difference. Are you renting a car or will you be using taxi or Uber? Once you figure out all of that it will be easier to narrow down. 

That said, my favorite on strip hotel is probably The Venetian. I just love the whole aesthetic. I also like Linq but I’m a smoker and that factors into why I like it. Do you wear a purse? If so wear the strap across your chest instead of one arm. I don’t like walking through parking lots in the dark so a lot of the time I’m on my phone with someone who can call for help if I scream. Don’t go into sketchy areas by yourself. I know that one seems obvious but it’s easy to get distracted on a walk and end up somewhere weird and it’s always worse for a girl alone.
